sloka: प्रत्युवाच ततः सा तु वरुणं प्राञ्जलिः स्थिता ।मित्रेणाहं वृता साक्षात्पूर्वमेव सुरेश्वर ।। ७.५६.१६ ॥
transliteration: pratyuvāca tataḥ sā tu varuṇaṁ prāñjaliḥ sthitā ।mitreṇāhaṁ vṛtā sākṣātpūrvameva sureśvara ।। 7.56.16 ॥

translations.english: Then she, standing with folded hands, replied to Varuna, saying, "O Lord of gods, I have already been directly chosen by Mitra."
